board.dram_basis: The captured X100V 3.01 stock address window contains distinct readable data through 0x3fffffff; this declares a 512 MiB execution bound and does not assert physical DRAM density.

adc_input.basis: Declared virtual XP4 startup samples; physical X100V idle samples are unmeasured.

gpio_input.basis: Declared virtual XP4 startup levels; physical X100V idle levels are unmeasured.

loader_handoff.basis: The X100V stock RAM capture observed the 0x5d0-byte loader boot-information block at 0x0000f86c and its identical kernel copy. The cold-boot word is a declared virtual input because its reset-time physical value was not sampled.

sensor_input.basis: Declared virtual X100V sensor-statistics scene; physical sensor timing is unmeasured.

serial_flash.basis: Declared virtual 64 MiB XP4 NOR input containing the registered update; the X100V device identity and timing are unmeasured.

geometry.basis: Declared virtual 64 MiB XP4 NOR geometry; the X100V device identity and timing are unmeasured.

1.basis: Declared virtual XP4 startup inputs; physical X100V SPI levels and power-controller values are unmeasured.

power_checksum_registers.basis: Declared virtual values follow the checked XP4 ROM-start harness. Register 16 supplies cold-boot reason 4 and register 25 reports USB power status 0x10; physical X100V values are unmeasured.

4.basis: Declared virtual X100V startup input; the physical SPI level is unmeasured.

5.basis: Declared virtual X100V startup input; the physical SPI level is unmeasured.

usb_cable.basis: Declared virtual disconnected high-speed USB cable input following the checked XP4 harness; the physical X100V VBUS pin is unmeasured.

usb_phy_input.basis: Virtual zeroed XP4 USB PHY input; physical X100V PHY reset values are unmeasured.

temperature_input.basis: Declared virtual ambient temperature of 25 C; physical temperature is unmeasured.

storage_slots.basis: X100V specifications: one SD card slot (UHS-I).
